module: Auxiliary power steering controller. Sets hydros.wheelPowerSteeringCoef (assist coefficient applied by the steering engine): fixed value 1 + constantOffset, or, if the parameters allow it, a value that varies linearly with wheel speed between speedSlow and speedFast.
notes: jbeam keys read in init: strengthFast (1), strengthSlow (1), speedSlow (0 m/s), speedFast (0 m/s), constantOffset (-0.2).

The variation with speed is only enabled if speedFast > speedSlow AND strengthFast > strengthSlow; otherwise M.updateGFX stays nil and only the fixed coefficient 1 + constantOffset is applied (an assist that would decrease with speed is therefore not handled).
Formula: coef = max(max((strengthFast-strengthSlow) * (min(speed, speedFast) - speedSlow) / (speedFast-speedSlow) + strengthSlow, 0) + constantOffset, 0), speed = electrics.values.wheelspeed (m/s).
M.updateGFX is nil at declaration and reassigned in init.

updateGFX.desc: Assist update function according to speed; nil if the controller does not vary.

init.desc: Reads the jbeam keys, sets hydros.wheelPowerSteeringCoef = 1 + constantOffset and enables updateGFX if the assist varies with speed.
